These are so soft and light on my head that sometimes I forget I have one on as I get ready in the morning! They are very absorbent and help my hair dry quickly.  Before finding these I would wrap my hair in a towel and my hair would still be too wet that it would soak my shirt top. reviews.t: These are amazing! My hair is curly so all I do ...
reviews.x: These are amazing! My hair is curly so all I do is wet comb my hair, throw it up in the towel, and get ready. When I take it off, I just let me hair air dry and it looks perfect. Highly recommend because it’s so gentle!

reviews.t: Seem like nice quality towels but not the colors as described ...
reviews.x: Seem like nice quality towels but not the colors as described more in the tan beige color family. Disappointing to see an open taped back together box the towels came in. This item was Suppose to be brand new. Poor quality from the seller.
This came on time, nicely wrapped. The towels are microfiber, but fluffy. I sleep with them on and my hair is full of body, but not full of static. I'd buy these again
I love these! They really soak up the water from wet hair. They dry quickly, are oh so soft and snuggly. It's a best buy! Great gift idea too.
Great and SOFT towls,however the eyehook for the button is Wayyyyy to big and wont stay fassned

I have thick, long hair that acts like a sponge, and this towel did absolutely nothing to help accelerate drying, I actually think it did the opposite!! My regular cotton towel is significantl more efficient. Also the towel wasn’t even long enough to cover all my hair. This is turban style, and also not what I wanted. Do not recommend.

reviews.t: liked and works good but they are not as big ...
reviews.x: liked and works good but they are not as big as I thought they would be.  Good for very short hair only

reviews.t: Falls apart and leaves you heartbroken
reviews.x: I initially really liked these, but now I wish I hadn't bought them. They don't absorb much, and after one wash one of them's button popped off. I brushed it off because I figured it was a one-off. However, I just pulled a second out of the wash, and it too lost its button. My remaining one has developed a hole but still has its button.  I have very short hair, and put little stress on the towel(s) when I do use them. Very disappointed.

These hair wraps are very soft, colors are lovely, and they get the job done. Only problem is...the first time I used one, the button popped off as soon as I pulled a sweater over my head (not an especially small neck opening on the sweater or anything). So now I'm down to only two, as it doesn't really work without a button to fasten at the back. The moral: If you order them, be very careful getting dressed!

These work well.  I can't tell if they dry my hair better than a regular towel, but I can wrap my hair up with one of these and it STAYS PUT, which I definitely can't do with a regular towel.  I'm not sure if I'm putting them on right, the instructions could have been a little more clear, but I suppose if it is holding my hair up and staying on, then I don't really have much to complain about!

I've had these towels for a couple months and they started falling apart after 2 washes. The seams are separating in various places and the buttons are falling off! I do like the microfiber material and they are lightweight and easy to use on my hair, but clearly there are some serious quality issues with these towels.

reviews.t: Love this product it allows my wavy hair to dry ...
reviews.x: Love this product it allows my wavy hair to dry naturally after use keeping moisture in and creates wonderful texture without frizz. Highly recommend easy to wrap hair like a turban with button closure. Soft and pretty material for that glamorous feeling.

These are the best towels I have ever used for my hair, beats other more expensive brands. The style is great, colors are pretty and I've ordered two sets so my daughter can benefit from them as well.

reviews.t: Must have for women or men who usually use two towels (one for hair, one for body)
reviews.x: Wish I had known about these sooner. I always use two towels and this makes it so that I only have to use one when I shower!

reviews.t: ... but they are sooo soft and the colors are super pretty and neutral
reviews.x: You have to wring them out a little after each use but they are sooo soft and the colors are super pretty and neutral.

reviews.x: They are very soft and absorbent.  I just don't like the turban thing.  I can't use it that way. it wont wrap right.

reviews.t: I like how it dries my hair but what I like ...
reviews.x: I like how it dries my hair but what I like the most is how it makes my hair soft and not frizzy
Nice, soft towels.  Didn't leave any lint in my hair, even though I didn't wash them first.

reviews.t: Super soft and absorbent. A steal at only $8 a piece
reviews.x: I got these as a Christmas gift after asking for some and they are amazing!! These are my first specific "head wrap towels" as I've only used the giant bath towels to dry my hair my entire life. I'm finally adulting in my 30th year and have a proper towel now. I love them because my hair is prone to breakage very easily (and I'm a quarter Armenain, what's up with that?) When I heard regular towels are horrible to dry your hair with, I knew I needed these in my life. They are so soft (even after

Live that it came in a pack of three, one for each of us girls in the house! This is my first hair towel, so I'm no expert, but it seems to only absorb a certain amount and then just sit there wet. I didnt notice much drying power to it, as some towels claim. But as far as a simple to wrap towel that's not heavy and bulky in the head, it's good to keep your hair from dripping for a bit while you're doing other things!

These are soooo soft and absorbent. I'm keeping 2 of them and giving away 1 to my daughter-in-law to share the love I have for this wrap. It's far better to use a microfiber towel to dry your hair than a regular towel. A towel can cause friction which will lead to frizzy hair. Using a soft microfiber hair wrap will allow the cuticles on your hair strands to lay flat and your hair will be smoother and shinier.

This wrap works for anyone with short hair too. It takes a time or two to get the hang of how to wrap the towel so it suits you best but all in all, it works great. It doesn't have the weight of a heavy bath towel on your head and the button in the back secures the wrap quite well. Three towels in one package is worth the price.

This was a gift so I don’t know exactly too much about the product itself.  It my sister has said that she loves it and it makes her hair so soft and beautiful. Also I love that the product arrived so much earlier that I had expected! And the delivery driver even took a photo of the delivery, to confirm receipt! How awesome!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the towels as soft, fluffy, and gentle on hair.
Many reviewers say the towels absorb water well and help hair dry quickly.
Several reviewers report durability problems, especially buttons popping off and seams separating.
Some reviewers find the towels too small or ineffective for long or thick hair.
A few reviewers mention color or packaging issues, including colors not as described and a taped box.
